channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: A Sector Darkly
item.description: Command a ship and crew stranded far from home in this open-world space sandbox RPG. Explore, trade, fight, and craft to survive among the strange alien factions. One by one entire sectors are going dark and no one knows why. Solve the mystery of the dark sectors and get your crew home.

item.title: Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss
item.description: Run your very own cat cafe! Lead your cats on adventures into a magical city, gather ingredients to cook scrumptious dishes, customize your dream cafe, and bring bliss to your loyal customers in this cozy management lifesim. 🐱

item.title: Fleshborn
item.description: A short incremental game where you are tasked to clean a lab from fleshy growths using your flamethrower. Collect resources and spend them in a vast upgrade tree to unlock new abilities.

item.title: Hotel Architect - Poolside Paradise
item.description: The Gran Canaria Hotel is opening and soon guests will be flying in from all over the globe to visit your subtropical island hotel in Hotel Architect - Poolside Paradise. Relaxation relies on careful planning, creative logistics, and a seasoned hotel manager. Do you have what it takes?

item.title: Me and You
item.description: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

item.title: METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.2
item.description: This second installment to the collection features “Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots” and “Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version),” and also a digital soundtrack and "Metal Gear: Ghost Babel" as bonus content.

item.title: SILENT HILL: Townfall
item.description: Returning to an island town to ‘put things right’, Simon Ordell descends into a world of tense evasion, explosive confrontations, and mind-bending puzzles that slowly surface the truth of St. Amelia.

item.title: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™
item.description: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ is a ​runs-based, ​high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

item.title: When Chests Rain Tons of Loot
item.description: An incremental loot game where you drop your heroes onto hordes of slimes. They do the fighting, you grab the loot and fill your treasure chest. When time runs out, it bursts and rains it all back down. Upgrade your army in a huge skill tree and go again for a bigger haul.

item.title: Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop
item.description: Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop is a cozy organizing simulator where you put back over 4,100 unique fish into their aquariums. Fill the tanks, unlock helpful abilities, and enjoy the satisfying loop of turning total aquatic chaos into a clean, well-organized shop at your own pace.

item.title: Food Devils
item.description: You're the last chef in a post-apocalyptic world. Attract adventurers with monstrous food, make them sign contracts with the Food Devils and organize expeditions to collect wicked ingredients! Customize your characters, build the perfect restaurant and plan every move in this Tactics-RPG Roguelite.

item.title: No Asteroids
item.description: An asteroid will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. Dig 5,000,000 m³ in first person, solo or in online co-op for up to 8. Sell the ore and buy ship guns that fire as you dig.

item.title: PC Store Together
item.description: Run your own PC shop with friends! Build and repair computers, diagnose faulty parts, stock shelves, set prices, sell hardware and custom PCs, serve customers, manage orders, upgrade your store, unlock new components and grow your business together.

item.title: Rekindled: Cozy Tavern Life
item.description: Rekindled is a co-op tavern game with a twist - there's no stress! Forage, Fish, Farm and Cook at your own pace, then decorate your dishes and tavern before welcoming your customers in.

item.title: SHRED A BILLION
item.description: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 999,999,999 bills left to go!

item.title: Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga - Hold the Line
item.description: Fight through 15 escalating defense battles in this strategy RPG expansion. Capture valuable nodes, launch daring counterattacks, recruit familiar heroes, strengthen your squads, earn army-wide bonuses between chapters, and push your army command skills to new heights.
